2607.15516.title: Cache-Aware Prompt Compression:A Two-Tier Cost Model for LLM API Caching
2607.15516.paper_summary: Production LLM deployments combine two cost-reduction primitives: prompt caching (a discounted rate for re-used token prefixes) and prompt compression (fewer tokens sent). The compression literature has standardized on query-aware methods that produce a different compressed prefix per query, mechanically invalidating the prefix-strict cache on every call. We characterize this cost empirically on Anthropic's Sonnet 4.6 API and find caching is far from the rho=1.0 ideal the literature assumes: Sonnet's cache has a two-tier architecture with a sharp threshold near 3,500 tokens, below which the hit rate plateaus at rho~0.83 across 30-call sessions. Our cost model predicts, and experiments confirm, that under realistic rho, query-aware compression beats naive caching at high compression ratios (r>=6). We propose Cache-Aware Prompt Compression (CAPC), pairing query-agnostic compression with explicit cache_control plus a tier-preserving ratio bound that prevents over-compression from pushing the cached prefix into the hot tier. CAPC is the cheapest strategy in 16/16 configurations on LongBench-v2, with mean savings of 49% over cache-only, 64% over query-aware compression, and 90% over vanilla, at quality within 0.05 of the uncompressed baseline. We validate CAPC on three production workloads: an enterprise tool-using assistant with a 94k-token schema prefix (51.7% cost reduction at r=3); a graphify knowledge-graph RAG pipeline across two codebases (9.3x vs cache-all on FastAPI, 2.4x on httpx); and the public tau-bench retail benchmark (50 tasks), where CAPC is the cheapest of four strategies with reward exactly equal to vanilla (both 36/50, p=1.00) while query-aware compression is the most expensive at +40.1% over vanilla -- the first production confirmation of the crossover model's negative-ROI prediction on a public benchmark.
2607.15516.paper_summary_zh: 生產 LLM 部署結合了兩種成本降低原則：提示緩存（對重用的標記前綴提供折扣率）和提示壓縮（發送的標記數量減少）。壓縮文獻已經標準化為查詢感知方法，這些方法為每個查詢產生不同的壓縮前綴，機械性地使每次調用都無效化前綴嚴格緩存。我們在 Anthropic 的 Sonnet 4.6 API 上對這一成本進行了實證特徵分析，發現緩存遠未達到文獻假設的 rho=1.0 理想值：Sonnet 的緩存具有兩級架構，在 3,500 個標記附近有一個明確的閾值，低於該閾值的命中率在 30 次調用會話中穩定在 rho~0.83。我們的成本模型預測，並且實驗確認，在現實的 rho 下，查詢感知壓縮在高壓縮比（r>=6）下優於簡單緩存。我們提出了 Cache-Aware Prompt Compression (CAPC)，將查詢無關的壓縮與明確的 cache_control 結合，並設置一個保留層級的比率限制，以防止過度壓縮將緩存前綴推入熱層。CAPC 在 LongBench-v2 的 16/16 配置中是最便宜的策略，平均節省成本為 49% 相較於僅緩存，64% 相較於查詢感知壓縮，90% 相較於原始版本，且質量在未壓縮基準線的 0.05 以內。我們在三個生產工作負載上驗證了 CAPC：一個使用 94k 標記架構前綴的企業工具助手（在 r=3 時成本降低 51.7%）；一個跨兩個代碼庫的圖形知識圖 RAG 管道（在 FastAPI 上比緩存全部快 9.3 倍，在 httpx 上快 2.4 倍）；以及公共 tau-bench 零售基準（50 個任務），在這裡 CAPC 是四種策略中最便宜的，獎勵與原始版本完全相等（均為 36/50，p=1.00），而查詢感知壓縮則是最貴的，比原始版本高出 40.1%——這是公共基準上交叉模型負 ROI 預測的首次生產確認。
2607.15516.author: Yan Song et.al.
